title: clippy: slot.rs:604 unnecessary_map_or breaks clippy -D warnings gate on current toolchain
description: Found while closing bead 3mz9 (2026-09-09): cargo clippy -p lichen-gateway --lib -- -D warnings fails with clippy 1.96.0: 'this map_or can be simplified' at rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs:604 (ordinal.map_or(true, |value| value >= MAX_COORDINATING_GATEWAYS as u64)). Pre-existing (file untouched by 3mz9); CI's pinned toolchain presumably older. Fix: rewrite as is_none_or (stable since 1.82) or restructure the guard. Sweep for other map_or(true/false, ...) instances while in the file.
